decision_basis: Constructed discipline control, not a documented November2022 refusal. Strong IP/parks are genuine counterevidence; the case hinges on uncertain transition economics.

drivers.driver: DTC losses, pricing/ad-tier changes and legacy distribution decline widen the forecast range beyond a simple brand-quality argument.
drivers.quote: We require a high degree of predictability in the businesses in which we invest due to the highly concentrated nature of our portfolio.

drivers.driver: Require owner cash after content and parks reinvestment, not subscriber scale or adjusted EPS alone. Current FCF yield and leverage do not provide an obvious margin of safety.

ackman_public_statement.quote: Only the company and its advisors have access to how shareholders have voted before the day of the annual meeting
ackman_public_statement.context: Later public governance/proxy comment supporting Peltz, not a November2022 buy/pass statement; confined to key.

outcome_note: No subsequent leadership change, cost savings, proxy result or return is used. PASS tests forecast discipline, not a universal Disney/media exclusion or a prediction the shares cannot recover.
